tfrHistoric.name: Gapminder — long-run total fertility rate
tfrHistoric.citation: Gapminder Foundation, compiled from Mattias Lindgren's historic “babies per woman” estimates (1800–1949) and UN World Population Prospects (1950–1959). Period TFR (not completed-cohort fertility). Pre-1960 estimates only; from 1960 birthrate.io uses World Bank WDI.
